  • Constructor Details

    • PbcsConnectionImpl

      public PbcsConnectionImpl(String server, String identityDomain, String username, String password)
      Builds a new PBCS Connection object. All fields are required except the identity domain. Gen2 servers do not need an identity domain, but it may be required for Gen1 servers.
      Parameters:
      server - the server, not including http and not containing anything after the TLD
      identityDomain - the identity domain for the user
      username - the username to connect with
      password - the password for the user

    • isToken

      public boolean isToken()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsConnection
      Checks if this connection object represents a username or an OAuth2 token. For the standard/historical connection implementation in PbcsConnectionImpl this is always false. For the new token implementation in PbcsConnectionToken, it is true.

      This is used by the client to determine how the authorization header is generated, i.e., if it's going to use HTTP Basic or a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

      Specified by:
      isToken in interface PbcsConnection
      Returns:
      true if it's a token, false otherwise

      public static PbcsConnectionImpl fromProperties(Properties properties)
      Convenience method that attempts to construct a new user connection details object from a Properties object that contains the following keys: server, identityDomain, username, password.

      If any of the fields are missing, an exception is thrown

      Parameters:
      properties - a Properties object that should contain the user details
      Returns:
      a new user connection details object based on the keys from the given properties
